# CC Babysitter

> Keeps Claude Code sessions alive and reachable. If the app running a babysat session closes, crashes or is killed, CC Babysitter starts the same session again in the background. Remote Control is on, so the session stays reachable from a phone. That app can be Claude Desktop, VS Code or a terminal. Where the system allows it, CC Babysitter itself runs in the background and starts again at login. On a headless server it runs as a user service that starts at boot, so babysat sessions survive SSH drops and reboots. Free, open source (MIT), for macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Install

- macOS and Linux: `curl -fsSL https://ccbabysitter.dev/install.sh | sh`
- Windows: `irm https://ccbabysitter.dev/install.ps1 | iex`
- Go: `go install ccbabysitter.dev/ccbabysitter/cmd/ccbabysitter@latest`

## Use it from an AI agent

- `ccbabysitter babysit self`: keep the Claude Code session the command runs in alive
- `ccbabysitter list --json`: every session on the machine, as JSON
- `ccbabysitter open`: open the page in the browser without printing its key
- `ccbabysitter --help`: all commands, and `ccbabysitter help <command>` for one
- In Claude Code: `/plugin install ccbabysitter --marketplace pejmanebrahimi/ccbabysitter`, then ask it to babysit a session

## Links

- [Docs](https://ccbabysitter.dev/docs/): how to use CC Babysitter
- [Babysit your first session](https://ccbabysitter.dev/docs/first-session/): a tutorial, from install to reaching the session from a phone
- [Run it on a server](https://ccbabysitter.dev/docs/server/): a how-to guide for a Linux server reached over SSH
- [Start at login](https://ccbabysitter.dev/docs/start-at-login/): check, turn on or turn off starting CC Babysitter at login
- [Use it from Claude Code](https://ccbabysitter.dev/docs/claude-code-plugin/): install the Claude Code plugin and babysit a session by asking for it
- [README](https://github.com/pejmanebrahimi/ccbabysitter): settings, uninstalling, and everything the docs do not cover yet
- [Releases](https://github.com/pejmanebrahimi/ccbabysitter/releases)
